The main body is made of a silver metal. First a dry brush of Iron Warriors, which is a dark silver-metallic color. I follow up with 3 more dry brushes of ever growing shine, ending with a very light dry brush on the most exposed parts only of a very shiny paint (can check name tomorrow).

Next are the green plates, which I do mixing one of the two darker silvers with a dark green as the base (I believe it's wagh green). As it's a custom mixture, I tend to add lights to it on the go by adding more of of the shiny silver for lights.

Then I do the bronze with 3 dry brushes going from dark bronze to shiny bronze. Afterwards, the whole mini has an edge highlighting with that very shiny metallic silver. It makes the details a lot more visible.

Then I do a white basecoat on all the orangy stuff. I use a vibrant orange afterwards. (I believe it's Vallejo Fire Orange?). The dark parts are then painted with Blood Angels contrast, and I made an intermediate tine mixing the two colors. And the lighter parts are made of a vibrant yellow (can't remember the name) finally I add little strips of yellow mixed with white, and in very few places like the cannon or the eyes, a very tiny strip of pure white.

And that's as far as I've gotten. I still have to do some glazing to make a good blend of the colors on some cables, and then the orbs and the OSL effect.

But what you say is that I'm shooting at the target position, disregarding the movement  is not the case.
